title: SOHCAHTOA
text: Sine of $$\theta$$ is the ratio of opposite over hypotenuse for a right triangle with angle $$\theta$$

title: Construct a right triangle
text: Construct a right triangle with angle $$\theta$$ so that $$\sin(\theta)=x.$$ \n We assume a triangle with hypotenuse $$1$$ and opposite side $$x.$$\n##figure1.gif##

figureAlts.figure1.gif: Diagram of a right reference triangle. An acute angle is labeled theta. The leg opposite angle theta is labeled x, and the hypotenuse is labeled one. The leg adjacent to angle theta is unlabeled.

title: The adjacent side
text: Compute the adjacent side from Pythagorean theorem.

figureAlts.figure2.gif: Diagram of a right reference triangle. An acute angle is labeled theta. The leg opposite angle theta is labeled x, and the hypotenuse is labeled one. The leg adjacent to angle theta is labeled as the square root of the quantity one minus x squared.

title: SOHCAHTOA
text: Tangent is opposite over adjacent. Combine those two algebraic pieces.\n##figure3.gif##

figureAlts.figure3.gif: Diagram of a right reference triangle. An acute angle is labeled theta. The leg opposite angle theta is labeled x, and the hypotenuse is labeled one. The leg adjacent to angle theta is labeled as the square root of the quantity one minus x squared.
